shortDescription: Manage QoS performance policies on Dell PowerStore

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: file_io_limit_rule
options.description: Name or ID of the file IO limit rule to associate. Only valid for C(File_Performance) policy type.

options.name: io_limit_rule
options.description: Name or ID of the IO limit rule to associate. Only valid for C(QoS) policy type.

options.name: new_name
options.description: New name for the QoS policy.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: policy_type
options.description: Type of QoS policy. C(QoS) for block resources (requires io_limit_rule). C(File_Performance) for file resources (requires file_io_limit_rule).

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: qos_policy_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the QoS policy.

options.name: qos_policy_name
options.description: The name of the QoS policy.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the QoS policy should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
